title: Coproducts of finite separable etale field spectra are etale
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], let I be a set, and for each i in I let L_i/K be a finite separable field extension (finite and separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]). Then the coproduct morphism (coprod_{i in I} Spec L_i) \to Spec K is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].
